name: Nanshan Aluminium International Holdings Limited
summary: Nanshan Aluminium International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the production and sale of alumina in Malaysia, Hong Kong, India, Switzerland, Singapore, the United States of America, Indonesia, and South Korea. The company offers aluminium hydroxide. It involved in the provision of management consultation services. It serves aluminium producers and commodity traders for manufacturing electrolytic aluminium. The company was founded in 2017 and is based in Bintan, Indonesia. Nanshan Aluminium International Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Nanshan Aluminium Investment Holding Limited.
